description: Makes a file of a design — PNG, JPG, PDF, MP4, WebM, GIF or Lottie — and returns a download link for the signed-in person, valid one hour. Use it when the person wants the file («give me a PNG», «PDF for print»). Rendered in the person’s open editor: ask them to open its link first. Example: { design, format: «pdf» }. The design does not change.

artboard.description: an artboard id from get_design; none: the first

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

format.description: the file type: an image, a print PDF, a video or animation of its motion; e.g. «png»

name: export_design
title: Export a file
